description: Write and ship a blog post for your project that reads like a human wrote it and pulls SEO traffic to your site. Use when a contributor wants to draft, edit, or publish a blog post, add a post to the site, write about the project for search/traction, or make an existing draft sound less like AI. Enforces the house voice (no em dashes), picks a non-cannibalizing angle, uses ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English for technical prose, wires the post into your site, and runs the humanizer pass before shipping.
